title.description: Diagram title. Rendered as the SVG <title> for accessibility.

direction.description: Default layout direction for views that do not set their own: edges run left-to-right ("right") or top-to-bottom ("down"). The only layout hint; positions are computed automatically and are deterministic.

groups.description: Containers drawn as labelled frames around their nodes: tiers, regions, clusters, trust boundaries. Nest via 'parent'. The group hierarchy is also the outline for navigation.

id.description: Unique identifier, referenced by nodes ('group'), groups ('parent') and views ('scope'). Shares the id space with nodes.

label.description: Title drawn on the frame. Defaults to the id.

kind.description: What the container represents; each has a distinct frame: tier (solid, tinted), region (dashed), zone (dotted), cluster (solid, darker), boundary (red dashed, no fill, for trust boundaries).

parent.description: Id of the enclosing group. Omit for top-level groups. Cycles are rejected.

id.description: Unique identifier referenced by edges. Letters, digits, '_', '.', '-'; must start with a letter or digit.

label.description: Text shown in the node box. Defaults to the id.

kind.description: What the component is. Chooses the glyph and carries meaning across views (e.g. a database is drawn as a cylinder everywhere).

group.description: Id of the group this node sits inside. Omit for top-level nodes.

state.description: Health in the base model. 'off' is deliberately switched off (dimmed); 'failed' is broken (red, pulsing); 'degraded' is partially working (amber). Propagation only ever worsens a node: dependents of an off or failed node fail (or degrade if covered by a healthy fallback), dependents of a degraded node degrade. Scenarios override this per step.

nodes.description: Components of the system. Order matters: nodes that end up side by side are placed in this order, so list the important ones first.

to.description: Target node id. The arrowhead is drawn here.

label.description: Short text drawn at the edge midpoint, e.g. a protocol or purpose.

load.description: Relative traffic on this edge, 0 to 1. Drives the flow animation: 0 hides the flow, 1 is the fastest and thickest dashes. Use it for relative intensity, not real units. Defaults to 0.5, or 0 for fallback edges.

id.description: Unique edge id. Defaults to "<from>-><to>"; give explicit ids when one pair of nodes has several edges. Reserved for future scenarios and interactions to reference.

kind.description: Nature of the connection: a synchronous call, an asynchronous message, data replication, or a bulk data flow. Chooses the line style and, later, whether it implies a dependency.

dependsOn.description: true: the source cannot work without the target. If the target is off or failed, the source fails, unless a fallback edge covering this edge is healthy, in which case the source is degraded. If the target is degraded, the source is degraded. "soft": the source only degrades when the target is down (a nice-to-have call). Degradation propagates up chains of dependsOn edges. Non-dependsOn edges never affect health.

fallback.description: Standby path for one dependsOn edge of the same source (named by fallbackFor). Usually load 0 in the base model; when the covered target is down it automatically carries that edge's load, no scenario step needed. A non-zero base load means active-active. Cannot be combined with dependsOn.

fallbackFor.description: Id of the dependsOn edge this fallback covers; must start at the same source. Optional when the source has exactly one dependsOn edge, required otherwise.

edges.description: Directed connections. Each 'from'/'to' must be an existing node id (checked by the validator); self-references, duplicate node ids and duplicate edge ids are rejected.

views.description: How to draw the model. Optional: without it, one topology view of everything is rendered. Each view may set its own direction and a 'scope' group to drill into.

id.description: Unique view id, used by `orrery render --view <id>`.

title.description: Title for this view. Defaults to the diagram title.

type.description: Kind of drawing. Only 'topology' exists today; 'sequence' and 'walkthrough' are planned.

direction.description: Layout direction for this view. Defaults to the top-level direction.

scope.description: Group id to drill into: the view shows that group as its outer frame, every group and node inside it, and only the edges whose both ends are inside. Edges that cross the scope boundary are not drawn. Omit to show everything.

scenarios.description: Named what-if timelines. Each step overrides node states and edge loads; steps are cumulative (step k applies steps 1..k). Render one with `orrery render --scenario <id> --step <n>`.

label.description: Human title. Defaults to the id.

steps.description: Ordered changes. A step must change at least one node or edge.

note.description: What happens in this step, shown during step-through.

edges.description: Edge id (default "<from>-><to>", or the explicit id) to load override (0..1). Fallback loads switch automatically; use this for other changes such as traffic shifting.
